prompt:
Hi — I'm Sarah, engineering lead for the payments team. We have a serious situation: our legacy payment module has been accumulating tech debt for three years and we have a hard compliance audit on November 15th. I've been taking rough notes about all the problems — the stripe SDK going EOL, a money-losing refund bug, missing rollback procedures, terrible test coverage, PII leaking into logs — but I don't have time to turn them into something coherent before Friday's architecture review.

I need you to read through everything in the workspace (my raw notes are in docs/refactor_raw_notes.txt, but there are also audit logs, meeting notes, and code files scattered around that are relevant) and produce a complete, structured refactor plan document called refactor_plan.md.

The plan needs to be something I can hand directly to the team and to the compliance officer. It should be concrete — not vague aspirations, but actual owners, deadlines, and commands where relevant. It needs to make clear what we do today versus what we tackle over the next week, what the risks are and what we do if things go wrong, and what assumptions we're making. Please ground everything in the actual evidence from the files, not generic advice.
